en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural landscape with a winding dirt road, open fields, scattered trees, a pond or river, and a few farm buildings in the distance. The caption over the image reads "Weg zur Aa." and to the right, on the blank part of the card, is the word "Wenden." Along the left border of the image is a vertical credit line for the photographer/publisher.
